subject.title: feishu_doc `create` action silently ignores `content` parameter — creates empty document

question: Should Feishu `create` with supplied content become a supported one-call create-and-write operation, or should the tool reject that parameter and keep the two-step create/write contract?
rationale: Both choices remove the silent-drop failure, but they define different tool semantics and recovery requirements when the write phase fails after document creation succeeds.

options.title: Support one-call create with content
options.body: Review and land the linked implementation path only if it preserves enough created-document identity for recovery and has focused Feishu tests.

options.title: Reject content on create
options.body: Make create-time content invalid at the schema/tool boundary and keep the skill/docs on the explicit create-then-write workflow.

recommendation.title: Support one-call create with content
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked implementation path only if it preserves enough created-document identity for recovery and has focused Feishu tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin reference names @m1heng as the community maintainer for this plugin surface, making them the best routing candidate for the contract choice.
